name: Pierced by Love
source: Your dreams are coming true! You’ve finally been accepted into the Imagawa College kyudo team alongside your childhood idol! But behind the curtain of prestige lie dark secrets that threaten to tear the club, and your budding relationship, apart. Finding love might not be in your sights, but it might be your only chance to save the club…
